Does not require independent evidence that the source report is complete or that all expected source sequence units arrived before completion.

Requires durable registration of `(report ID, checksum)`, no-op behavior for identical completed replay, deterministic resume for in-progress replay, and rejection of checksum changes under the same ID.
Mentions report versions and lineage but does not require persisting the parser version needed to reproduce normalization and matching decisions.

Requires component-scoped reconciliation and same-currency balanced corrections, but does not require each match group to satisfy a currency-preserving equation across captures, refunds, fees, and adjustments.
Condemns binary floating point, epsilon matching, fixed `* 100` scaling, and truncation; it does not endorse them.
Condemns deleting the predecessor and requires immutable, queryable superseded reports.
Condemns `UpdatePostedAmount` and requires immutable posted journals with append-only corrections.
Condemns fresh UUIDs as retry deduplication identities and requires deterministic durable uniqueness.
Does not address aggregate-net-total matching as an acceptable proof of item-level reconciliation and does not endorse it.

It omits explicit match-group/exception exclusivity, correction-driven rematch and reversal work, per-line completion classification, independent source-completeness evidence, parser-version persistence, and a currency-preserving reconciliation equation across lifecycle components.
